arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tmp/t_input.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys
CLI = "/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py"
def run_raw(data):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, CLI], input=data, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode(), p.stderr.decode()

cases = [
  (b'{"types":[],"modules":[],"calls":[],"pipes":[],"entries":[],"machine":null,"runs":[]}',
   '{"plans":[],"records":[],"corpus":[]}'),
  (b'{"a":1} {"b":2}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'{"a":1, "a":2}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'{"a":NaN}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'{"a":Infinity}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'{"a":1e999}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'{"a":1}trailing', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'not json', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'\xff\xfe', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'{"a":"\xed\xa0\x80"}', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
  (b'[]', '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'),
]
for data, want in cases:
    code, out, err = run_raw(data)
    ok = (code == 0 and out.strip() == want)
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"), repr(data[:30]), "->", out.strip()[:60], "" if ok else ("want " + want))
    assert ok, (data, out, want)

# size cap
big = b'{"types":[],"modules":[],"calls":[],"pipes":[],"entries":[],"machine":null,"runs":[],"pad":"' + b'a'*(64*1024*1024) + b'"}'
code, out, err = run_raw(big)
print("size cap:", code, out.strip()[:60])
assert code == 0 and out.strip() == '{"error":"INVALID_INPUT"}'
# exactly at cap minus overhead should still parse
data = b'{"types":[],"modules":[],"calls":[],"pipes":[],"entries":[],"machine":null,"runs":[],"pad":"12345678"}'
code, out, err = run_raw(data)
print("small:", code, out.strip()[:80])
PYEOF
python3 /workspace/tmp/t_input.py
